name: Caitlin Cattelino
subject: Take Action: Tell your Representative to vote NO on BAAJA
body:
BAAJA is headed for a House vote. Urge your Representative to reject this assault on the Endangered Species Act!
BAAJA is headed for a House vote. Urge your Representative to reject this assault on the Endangered Species Act!
| [](https://support.defenders.org/s/6363964/38SyG9Xl)
---
| | |
---
#
Defender, _Earlier this week, my colleague, Chris, urged you to contact your Representative about opposing BAAJA, the permitting bill that unfortunately passed the Senate._ _I wanted to echo Chris's request and also provide you with some additional resources and actions to take._[**_Our BAAJA Advocacy Toolkit_**](https://support.defenders.org/s/6363965/38SyG9Xl) _includes background information, a sample call script and a letter to the editor template._**_Any action you can take is critical as we understand the vote in the House could be as early as next week!_** _If you have any questions, need additional resources, or would like an extra set of eyes to review your message to your Representative, please feel free to reach out._ **_Imperiled wildlife are depending on us. We must do all we can to protect them. Your voice, passion and action can make a difference!_** _Thank you for all that you do,_ _Caitlin, Director of National Outreach_
#
|
---
[](https://support.defenders.org/s/6363966/38SyG9Xl)
---
| | |
---
#
|
---
[SIGN NOW: Tell the House to Keep Threatened and Endangered Animals Protected!](https://support.defenders.org/s/6363967/38SyG9Xl)
---
| | |
---
#
Defender,
#
**The House is about to decide the fate of America’s imperiled wildlife, and your voice is needed right now!**
#
[**Will your Representative defend the Endangered Species Act, or help bulldoze it?**](https://support.defenders.org/s/6363968/38SyG9Xl) If we don’t speak up now, wolves, grizzly bears, sea turtles and countless other imperiled species could pay the price.
#
The Senate has now passed the Bipartisan American Affordability and Jobs Act of 2026 (BAAJA), and it is headed to the House. Don’t let the name fool you: this bill is one of the most damaging attacks on wildlife we have ever seen. **If it becomes law, it will rewrite the ESA, our country’s strongest tool for protecting wildlife and preventing extinction, in profound and dangerous ways.**
#
**Here’s the good news: the House can still stop this. Your Representative can vote NO on final passage of BAAJA.**
#
[**The House vote could come at any moment, so there is no time to lose! Send an urgent message now and call on your Representative to protect endangered wildlife by voting NO.**](https://support.defenders.org/s/6363969/38SyG9Xl)
#
|
---
[TELL YOUR REPRESENTATIVE: VOTE NO!](https://support.defenders.org/s/6363970/38SyG9Xl)
---
| | |
---
#
**What makes BAAJA so dangerous? Plenty.**
#
* It will **cut federal wildlife scientists out of decisions** about projects that threaten endangered animals, removing a critical safeguard against extinction.
* It will **leave endangered animals extremely vulnerable** by shifting conservation responsibilities to underfunded, understaffed state agencies.
* It will **weaken protections across the country** by gutting the national system for protecting endangered species, replacing it with a patchwork of **_up to 50 different state processes,_** leaving wildlife with dangerously inconsistent protections.
* It will completely **exempt some highway and water projects from endangered species requirements** and never even ask the question whether the project might jeopardize the existence of threatened or endangered species-- effectively creating two **God Squads without the squad!**

#
**Worse still, Congress is racing to push these sweeping changes through in a lame-duck session, before newly elected members even take their seats and have a say.**
#
|
---
[TELL YOUR REPRESENTATIVE: VOTE NO!](https://support.defenders.org/s/6363971/38SyG9Xl)
---
| | |
---
#
The evidence is clear: the ESA is not the roadblock to development that its opponents claim it is. BAAJA would weaken core wildlife protections while ignoring the real problems that slow projects down.
#
The ESA has saved more than 99% of listed species from extinction. We can’t let a rushed vote tear it down.
#
[**Your Representative can still choose wildlife over this rushed bill. Make sure they hear from YOU today: tell them to vote NO on BAAJA.**](https://support.defenders.org/s/6363972/38SyG9Xl)
#
Thank you for standing up for threatened and endangered animals.
#
Sincerely,
#
|

---
| **Chris Westfall** Sr. Government Relations Legislative Counsel
Defenders of Wildlife

Thank you for all that you do, Caitlin, Director of National Outreach | | | | | | | | Defender, The House is about to decide the fate of America’s imperiled wildlife, and your voice is needed right now! If we don’t speak up now, wolves, grizzly bears, sea turtles and countless other imperiled species could pay the price. The Senate has now passed the Bipartisan American Affordability and Jobs Act of 2026 (BAAJA), and it is headed to the House. Don’t let the name fool you: this bill is one of the most damaging attacks on wildlife we have ever seen. If it becomes law, it will rewrite the ESA, our country’s strongest tool for protecting wildlife and preventing extinction, in profound and dangerous ways. Here’s the good news: the House can still stop this. Your Representative can vote NO on final passage of BAAJA. | | | | What makes BAAJA so dangerous? Plenty. It will cut federal wildlife scientists out of decisions about projects that threaten endangered animals, removing a critical safeguard against extinction. It will leave endangered animals extremely vulnerable by shifting conservation responsibilities to underfunded, understaffed state agencies. It will weaken protections across the country by gutting the national system for protecting endangered species, replacing it with a patchwork of up to 50 different state processes, leaving wildlife with dangerously inconsistent protections. It will completely exempt some highway and water projects from endangered species requirements and never even ask the question whether the project might jeopardize the existence of threatened or endangered species-- effectively creating two God Squads without the squad! Worse still, Congress is racing to push these sweeping changes through in a lame-duck session, before newly elected members even take their seats and have a say. | | | | The evidence is clear: the ESA is not the roadblock to development that its opponents claim it is. BAAJA would weaken core wildlife protections while ignoring the real problems that slow projects down. The ESA has saved more than 99% of listed species from extinction. We can’t let a rushed vote tear it down. Thank you for standing up for threatened and endangered animals. Sincerely, | | | Chris Westfall Sr. Government Relations Legislative Counsel Defenders of Wildlife | | Defenders of Wildlife 1130 17th Street NW • Washington, DC 20036 * Photo Credit: Gray Wolf © kjekol/iStockphoto

Dear Patriot,
[No vote cast. Two felonies. Donate.]
[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.
My name is James O'Keefe. I'm an undercover journalist, and a
prosecutor in Minnesota has charged me with two felonies.

The charges are unlawful voting and identity theft. They stem from a
hidden-camera report on how Minnesota's voter “vouching” law
works. NO OATH WAS SIGNED. NO BALLOT WAS ISSUED. NO VOTE WAS CAST. The
prosecutor herself said it is “pretty clear” we did not intend to
vote. Still, the two counts together carry up to 10 years in prison
and $20,000 in fines.

On November 16, I stood before a judge in Minneapolis. Since then,
people keep asking me, “JAMES, WHAT HAPPENS NOW?” So here is where
things stand, and the road ahead, with no spin.

[Stand with James. Donate now.]
[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.

STAND WITH JAMES — GIVE TO THE O'KEEFE DEFENSE FUND HOSTED BY
LIBERTY GUARD →
[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.

Done: the summons.

It ordered me to appear in Minneapolis and warned, in capital letters,
that if I didn't, “A WARRANT FOR YOUR ARREST SHALL BE ISSUED.” I
showed up.

Done: the first appearance.

I stood before a judge in Minneapolis on November 16 while the charges
were read. The case is now pending, and I'm due back in court in
January.

Next: the hearings, starting in January.

This is where many cases are won or lost. The law bars misrepresenting
your identity “in applying for a ballot.” I never asked for a
ballot or signed anything. The complaint relies on a state election
manual to argue otherwise, and my attorneys can ask the judge to throw
these charges out.

Then, if it comes to it: trial.

If the state won't drop this, we go before a jury, with weeks of
preparation and witnesses.

CHIP IN $35 — O'KEEFE DEFENSE FUND HOSTED BY LIBERTY GUARD →
[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.

Every one of those steps costs money.

01
MINNESOTA DEFENSE LAWYERS who know these courts.

02
TRAVEL to every court date.

03
FILINGS AND TRANSCRIPTS, which add up fast.

04
INVESTIGATORS to go through every frame of footage.

05
TRIAL PREP, if it comes to that.

A full felony defense through trial can run into six figures.

The state doesn't have to worry about any of that, because it has an
entire office of prosecutors paid for by taxpayers.

I have you.

YES, I'LL HELP COVER JAMES'S LEGAL COSTS — DONATE NOW →
[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.

Patriot, this is how lawfare works. The government doesn't have to
win. It only has to make the fight so long and so expensive that the
defendant runs out of money or gives up.

I'm not giving up. But I can't pay for this alone.

Please give $35, or whatever you can, to the O'Keefe Defense Fund
hosted by Liberty Guard before I'm back in court.
[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.

In Truth,
[James O'Keefe]
JAMES O'KEEFE
Founder and CEO
O'Keefe Media Group

P.S. The state has a whole office of lawyers on the taxpayer's dime. I
have you. Please give $35 so I'm ready for court.
[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.

On September 10, 2025, Charlie Kirk was shot dead at a folding table on a Utah college campus, mid-debate, doing the one thing that made his movement work: standing in front of young people and asking for their vote. Thirteen months later, the exit polls delivered his eulogy in reverse and _nobody is talking about it_. Democrats won the House 259-176 and the Senate 56-44, flipping nine Republican-held seats -- including Kansas, which hadn't elected a Democrat in a century. The party's worst midterm in a generation. But the autopsy isn't in the seat counts. It's in two numbers that should frighten _every_ Republican operative in Washington.
**Number one** : voters under 30 backed House Democrats 66 to 31. In 2024, that same cohort split roughly down the middle for Trump. _A 35-point swing in 24 months_.
**Number two** : in the 343 counties the Washington Post calls evangelical hubs, turnout ran at just 66 percent of 2024 levels. White evangelicals were 17 percent of the electorate -- _down from a quarter_ in the presidential year -- and evangelical leaders took to social media to publicly scold their own flocks for not showing up. The 82 percent who did vote stayed loyal. The problem is the pews were empty.
The faithful didn't defect. They vanished. And the young didn't drift right -- they came home. That is not a messaging failure. That is what happens when a movement loses the one man who was making its voters, and assumes the machine will run itself.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/c91c3fb2-5346-4aa4-a1b7-6fa164972780?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
To understand why, go back sixty years, to the last time American religion and American politics fused around a single man...

**November 25, 2026**
"To care for him who shall have borne the battle, and for his widow, and his orphan."
Abraham Lincoln spoke these words in his Second Inaugural Address in 1865, as the Civil War was drawing to a close.
More than a century and a half later, they still remind us that service does not end when someone comes home, and sacrifice does not end when someone does not.
Today, we give thanks to the veterans among us and remember those who are no longer here. We recognize those who carried the uniform, those who carried the memories, and the families who carried the worry and waited for them to return.
Some came home. Some did not. All deserve our gratitude.
To every veteran, living and departed, and to the families who stood beside them: thank you.
Your service is part of the story of this country, and it is our responsibility to ensure that sacrifice is never forgotten.
**Pause.
Breathe.
Look Deeper.**
**Refuel.**
**Welcome to Sweet Ground.**

| Hi Peter,

It's Thanksgiving weekend, which means it's time for a yearly tradition: arguing with your "pro-life" uncle about why women deserve basic human rights!

Maybe it's not your uncle. Maybe it's an aunt, a grandpa, or a second cousin once removed who can't stop complaining about abortion and cheering on cruel bans.

Next time they bring it up, try this: [Women in states with abortion bans are nearly twice as likely to die during pregnancy.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/144028812/662195929/2083279013?sourceid=1151747&utm_campaign=27emkge-1108aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=thanksgiving&amtOpts=&recurringAmtOpts=&am=&recurringAm=&is_optimized_ask=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3MzE3ZGIzYy1lMGU4LWYxMTEtOTFmMy0wMDBkM2E1MzMxOWIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=naFatQ-FubS_dcIAVUDXiLK7XBzIZ9q5zi9pArTIMmg=&emci=474e0e54-cde6-f111-91f3-000d3a533978&emdi=7317db3c-e0e8-f111-91f3-000d3a53319b&ceid=954237) That's a real, deadly fact. But your cousin who gets all his news from podcast bros probably won't care.

We know how to win arguments at the Center. We do it all the time in courtrooms around the world. That's why we know the best way to win is by taking action.

So skip the shouting match. Show your anti-rights relatives exactly what you believe in. name: Democrats.org
subject: Next Thanksgiving…
body:
We need to make sure that Dems have delivered real relief for American families. [ ](https://ak.democrats.org/go/98055?t=1&akid=10380%2E22930333%2EurhE-R)
---
Derek, Every Thanksgiving, we gather with friends and family across political lines to break bread. We know the last couple of years haven’t always been easy — especially with the hardships that too many Americans are facing due to job losses, groceries and childcare prices skyrocketing, and the division that Trump has sowed. Democrats are going to fight so that by this time next year, Congress has delivered real relief for American families. That means passing legislation to bring down the price of groceries and everyday goods, expand affordable healthcare, end Donald Trump’s illegal wars, and lift up hardworking Americans and their families, not billionaires. Even after Democrats’ major victories this year, making lasting change will require building Democratic power from the ground up at the local, state, and national levels. It’ll require electing a Democratic president to the White House who will sign laws to help the American people. And it’ll require that Democrats stay ready to defend our democracy against whatever attacks Donald Trump launches on it next. In less than two years, we’ll have the opportunity to elect a Democratic president who will help America move past the chaos of the MAGA movement. We don’t yet know who our nominee will be, but we know that the DNC will be ready to rally behind them the moment they’re chosen to help them win and lead America forward. **But getting there will take sustained grassroots support and energy.** The work that the DNC does, including registering new Democratic voters, investing over $1 million every month into state Democratic parties, and maintaining our world-class data and tech infrastructure that campaigns rely on, is sustained by grassroots Democrats who chip in during the “off-season.” It’s sustained by folks who chip in a few dollars a month when the media stops covering elections, but our organizing continues. Donors like them allow us to plan ahead and expand our work to have an even bigger impact in future elections. So, as we reflect on and celebrate the incredible victories that Democrats won this year, we want you to know how grateful we are to have you on our team. As we shift our sights to the White House and the 2028 elections, we’re excited for what’s to come and to continue fighting for hardworking Americans with you, Derek. **[DONATE](https://ak.democrats.org/go/89866?c0=em-dnc-november-2026-gfr.9s4leO&amount=7&refcode=em_20261125_10380_fr&t=5&akid=10380%2E22930333%2EurhE-R)** Thank you, The Democrats

_If you gave recently via check or mail, our system may not have yet processed your gift. We are appreciative and thank you greatly for your support._

A pro-ICE listener called into Chris Cuomo's live show, **[directly challenging him about his outrage](https://substack.com/redirect/b7d7c936-1404-448e-9a1a-f9f06cb89020?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** over a recent viral ICE arrest at a Seattle airport where agents appeared to drag deportable targets as they resisted arrest.
"You side with them... They broke the law! We have to follow laws in this country, do we not?!" the caller pressed Cuomo.
Cuomo flew off the handle, asking the caller, "Do you want me to beat the piss out of you with a stick in front of your family, because you committed a misdemeanor?!!"

# **Seeya! Kilmar Abrego Garcia lands in Spain, ending high-profile deportation saga**
Kilmar Abrego Garcia **[landed in Madrid](https://substack.com/redirect/45909313-ec6e-49a8-a7ec-73f1e7b9cf74?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** Tuesday under a court-ordered departure, with plans to eventually travel to Mexico; his attorney called it a "temporary departure," citing potential future pathways to return given his marriage and child who are U.S. citizens.
[| | | | | Secretary Markwayne Mullin

* **DHS Secretary Markwayne Mullin and former press secretary Karoline Leavitt celebrated the departure** , maintaining Abrego Garcia is a gang member and criminal threat who paid for his own flight and received no government incentives, with DHS insisting he will never return.
* **The case capped a nearly two-year legal battle** after Abrego Garcia was deported to a Salvadoran maximum-security prison despite a court order barring his removal there, with the administration later attempting to send him to Liberia before his voluntary departure to Spain.

# **Trump plans to meet Abdul El-Sayed, open to "Trumpcare" branding**
President Donald Trump told The NY Post he'll meet with Sen.-elect Abdul El-Sayed **[to discuss health care](https://substack.com/redirect/e0ed1380-7d83-4c81-b736-967c5443ae1e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** , praising El-Sayed's move to rebrand his "Medicare for All" proposal as "Trumpcare" as "very smart" and expressing optimism about finding middle ground.
* **Trump said:** "He's a smart guy,... I know I'll be meeting with him,... Maybe there's some place in the middle that we could go."

[| | | | | Dr. Abdul El-Sayed

This is a message for @realDonaldTrump . Donald, this is on the table. Guarantee healthcare for every American, from cradle to grave.

* **The shift marks a dramatic tone change from the campaign trail,** when Trump called El-Sayed a "jihadist lunatic" and El-Sayed accused Trump of hateful rhetoric; El-Sayed has said he's open to naming the plan after Trump if it helps get it passed.
* **Trump said he expects to meet frequently with incoming Democratic leaders Chuck Schumer and Hakeem Jeffries,** expressing broader interest in bipartisan deals, while acknowledging Republicans generally oppose single-payer health care due to its high projected costs despite lower out-of-pocket expenses for patients.

# **Melania Trump reunites more Russian, Ukrainian children with families**
First Lady Melania Trump **[announced the reunification of nine children](https://substack.com/redirect/f64b2933-4d48-4b33-bb81-612edc8f6d74?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** with their families Wednesday, marking her seventh such effort and bringing the total to 43 children reunited amid the ongoing Russia-Ukraine war, achieved with cooperation from both countries' leaders.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/f64b2933-4d48-4b33-bb81-612edc8f6d74?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **The reunification follows her recent role in securing a "localized ceasefire" in Ukraine's Kherson region,** which the White House credits with saving nearly 800 lives and enabling delivery of food, water, and medical aid.
* **Melania framed the effort as part of a broader humanitarian mission to bring peace through children,** saying reunification moves the world closer to healing. The announcement came amid a busy holiday schedule, including the White House Christmas tree unveiling and the annual turkey pardon, ahead of the Trumps' trip to Mar-a-Lago for Thanksgiving.

* * *
# **US economy revised up to 4.3% growth in third quarter - Fastest growth in 3 years**
The Bureau of Economic Analysis sharply **[revised third-quarter GDP growth upward](https://substack.com/redirect/e6403232-bc0f-4c24-903b-521aba4291e2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** to a 4.3% annual rate, well above the initial 3.4% estimate and nearly double the second quarter's 2.2% pace, exceeding even the most optimistic economist forecasts.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e6403232-bc0f-4c24-903b-521aba4291e2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Consumer spending rose 4.2%,** driven by higher outlays on prescription drugs, software, and gasoline, while business fixed investment surged 16.1%, fueled by strong equipment spending and revised software price data; housing investment declined 3.4%.
* **Inventory buildup added 1.64 percentage points to growth,** while trade subtracted 3.21 points as imports outpaced exports. Real gross domestic income also jumped to 4.4%, up sharply from 2.3% the previous quarter.

catching up, eating too much, and maybe waiting for that one relative to

Facebook this week.

the same social media feeds where right-wing lies spread fastest.

The number of people we are able to reach depends on the resources we are

| | Happy Thanksgiving! Here is a little Holiday-themed throwback for you...back during my days as a TV News Anchor, I showed the people of Pennsylvania how to make my famous smashed potatoes. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/144032330/662203232/1018104031?source=JS_EM_FR_112626_B1_Potatoes_Res2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDg3MTMiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZTE3ZjlkMGMtZTJlOC1mMTExLTkxZjMtMDAwZDNhNTMzMTliIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=7YQq_ukIOqyV8Z5W8u9T5U6OWqi4k9QvZTEZfPxYjf4=) I always say you can never have too many potatoes at a Thanksgiving table! From what tastes good to what feels good, smashed potatoes are my ultimate comfort food. And they're a crowd pleaser. Hopefully, my recipe will help you wow your crowd this holiday season!
1. Take the biggest potatoes you can find. I like to use Idaho potatoes! You are going to wash and peel them, and then toss those babies in a pot to boil with a bunch of salt.
2. Once they are boiled, strain them, and then get them right back into the hot pot you boiled them in. Add some butter and a little olive oil, and set them aside.
3. In a saucepan, add some chicken bouillon and water or chicken stock, a whole lot of garlic cloves, celery salt, celery seed, and, for a little kick, some cayenne pepper.
4. Once those ingredients are heated and combined, pour the mixture over the potatoes and add some sour cream and a little milk.
5. The final step is to smash it together! I like to use a hand masher. It was my grandmother's, and it does the trick!

Thank you so much for everything that you have done to support our campaign this year. It does not go unnoticed! I am so thankful this holiday season, and every day, that I have such an incredible team working with me. We will deliver better for PA next year. I can't wait to get to work for you. All the best, Janelle [**_P.S. My team and I are already trying to build up our warchest for 2028. As a new frontliner, we will be incredibly vulnerable to the GOP's attacks, but if this election taught us anything, it's that grassroots support matters. If you’d like to unsubscribe, | | Happy Thanksgiving! Here is a little Holiday-themed throwback for you...back during my days as a TV News Anchor, I showed the people of Pennsylvania how to make my famous smashed potatoes. = I always say you can never have too many potatoes at a Thanksgiving table! From what tastes good to what feels good, smashed potatoes are my ultimate comfort food. And they're a crowd pleaser. Hopefully, my recipe will help you wow your crowd this holiday season! 1. Take the biggest potatoes you can find. I like to use Idaho potatoes! You are going to wash and peel them, and then toss those babies in a pot to boil with a bunch of salt. 2. Once they are boiled, strain them, and then get them right back into the hot pot you boiled them in. Add some butter and a little olive oil, and set them aside. 3. In a saucepan, add some chicken bouillon and water or chicken stock, a whole lot of garlic cloves, celery salt, celery seed, and, for a little kick, some cayenne pepper. 4. Once those ingredients are heated and combined, pour the mixture over the potatoes and add some sour cream and a little milk. 5. The final step is to smash it together! I like to use a hand masher. It was my grandmother's, and it does the trick! Thank you so much for everything that you have done to support our campaign this year. It does not go unnoticed! I am so thankful this holiday season, and every day, that I have such an incredible team working with me. We will deliver better for PA next year. I can't wait to get to work for you. #### The Price Tag
## **The Fed 's favorite inflation gauge runs hotter, and a December hike draws closer**
_Incomes rose in October. Spending, once prices are counted, did not._
Our partner above is making a bold call about where artificial intelligence takes markets by the end of the month. The number that moved first this morning came from a far plainer place: a Commerce Department spreadsheet.
[The government's October price report](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/6a012b10-5037-45a1-8c9f-b9803dfe1ccc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) showed the price index the Federal Reserve watches most closely up 3.8 percent from a year earlier, after 3.6 percent in September. Core prices, which leave out food and energy, rose 3.3 percent, up from 3.1 percent and a tenth of a point above what forecasters expected. On a monthly basis, core prices rose 0.3 percent for the second month in a row.
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/6930d8d8-4acc-43ca-8981-20b3d1ed4f0f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Incomes did their part. Personal income jumped 0.7 percent in the month, yet once prices are counted, [household spending slipped slightly](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/4ba32e28-45a7-4eeb-9ab7-984fe0ea0e9f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
That leaves the Fed in an awkward spot two weeks before its final meeting of the year on Dec. 8-9. It raised rates in September for the first time in more than three years, and traders already saw another quarter-point move in December as the likely outcome. A hike would carry the prime rate up with it, and the prime rate is what most credit cards and home equity lines are priced from.
I read the flat spending figure as the line to watch: when people earn more and buy less, they are telling you how much they trust next month's prices.
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/7c2a6034-cf30-4800-b99c-e48b9192d3ab?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/f944e21f-ec99-4805-8489-01d319c9bb6e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Some costs of getting older show up in the mirror, and our next partner has its own idea about those.

If you want younger-looking skin, do THIS before you apply makeup...
1.) Look in the mirror
2.) Touch your face like[ ](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/b8c5ce12-b4e8-4d0a-a142-dcb6eb3e9427?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[THIS](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/b8c5ce12-b4e8-4d0a-a142-dcb6eb3e9427?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
3.) Apply your makeup like normal
It sounds impossible, but this "makeup hack" can help diminish the look of fine lines and wrinkles.*
**[>> 7-Second Makeup Hack "Fills In" the Look of Wrinkles](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/b8c5ce12-b4e8-4d0a-a142-dcb6eb3e9427?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
*All individuals are unique. Your results can and will vary.
#### The January Check
**Medicare 's 2027 bill rises $6.50, and this time the raise covers it**
Medicare has set its numbers for 2027, and they land with the first Social Security deposit of the year. For the first time since 2023, the Part B premium is rising more slowly than the cost-of-living adjustment. Part B covers doctor visits and outpatient care, and for most people the premium is taken straight out of the Social Security benefit.
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/18f07c03-9289-43b4-9a7b-265065779e1e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* The standard Part B premium climbs $6.50 to $209.40 a month, and the annual deductible rises $9 to $292, according to [Medicare's official notice](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/c0328841-01d3-4a4a-ba3a-3833b76c9048?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
* Social Security's 3.6 percent raise adds about $75 a month for the average retired worker, which leaves [roughly $68.50 after Medicare](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/f95ed0a3-d51d-441a-939b-f194f78905a5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
* Higher earners pay more: single filers with 2025 income above $112,000 owe at least $293.10 a month for Part B.
* Open enrollment for Medicare Advantage and drug plans closes Dec. 7, the last easy window to compare coverage before the new prices start.

The two changes meet on a single line of the January benefit statement, and for the average retired worker that line ends up about $68 a month higher.
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/0bac430c-e426-496a-8862-5d589c0f40ac?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
#### One Number
**$3.61** was the national average for a gallon of regular on Tuesday, according to [AAA's daily price tracker](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/39a56e93-4465-41e2-b8b1-39b086c943f9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), about 68 cents cheaper than a month ago. On a 15-gallon fill-up, that is roughly $10 back for the drive to Thanksgiving dinner. Gas still costs more than 50 cents a gallon above a year ago, so the relief is real but partial.
#### Why I Led Here
I put inflation on top because this morning's report is the last big one the Fed sees before it decides in two weeks, and that decision reaches most card balances and home equity lines in the country. The saving rate of 4.1 percent is the figure I keep coming back to.
What I honestly cannot tell yet is which gives way first, prices or shoppers. If it is shoppers, the Fed may not need to push as long as the headlines suggest, and I would rather keep some dry powder in cash than guess wrong in either direction.
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/9926b29c-4d3a-4b0a-9826-da4f3c74820d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/b220382d-fba0-4f1c-acf1-64f0f22ddd78?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
_When the world moves, hold your ground._

**DEMOCRAT SAM RASOUL AND REPUBLICAN TIM GREENWAY JOIN TOGETHER TO DENOUNCE RECENT ICE ACTIONS IN ROANOKE VALLEY** On Tuesday morning, two elected officials with distinctly different general political ideals -- Del. Sam Rasoul of Roanoke and Roanoke County School Board member Tim Greenway -- joined together to denounce U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement activity in the region. During a press conference at Roanoke's Williamson Branch Library, they said that policy changes on the federal level need to be made and that conversations about immigration need to happen across the aisle...."We have students who are not going to school, people who are not going to work, taxpaying, even citizens, who are worried about what will happen to me and my family," Rasoul said.

**JUDGE RULES BOTETOURT COUNTY GOOGLE DATA CENTER VIOLATED LAW, HALTS CONSTRUCTION** A Virginia judge on Monday ruled that the Botetourt County Board of Supervisors violated the state's Freedom of Information Act when it approved a performance agreement in June for a Google data center. The lawsuit was filed by Robert Dallas, who lives less than half a mile from the proposed 300-acre data center campus at Greenfield Industrial Park in Daleville. Dallas' petition accused the Botetourt County Board of Supervisors, Google and its subsidiary, Helio, of deliberately keeping the public in the dark about the project....In his ruling, Judge Michael Doucette agreed with the plaintiff and said the vote by the board during the meeting was void and ordered any construction or activity related to the performance agreement to stop.

**YOUR THANKSGIVING POLITICAL SURVIVAL GUIDE**
_Three courses. Three talking points. Zero guarantees of a drama-free dinner._
**COURSE #1: THE APPETIZER**
**Your uncle says: “The Democrats have gone way too far left!”**
**Your response:** Tell him about **Sen.-elect Mary Peltola,** who just won a U.S. Senate seat in Alaska — a state that voted for Donald Trump in 2024.
Mary's campaign wasn't about partisan politics. It was about making life better for working Alaskans. She traveled across the state by plane, boat, and snowmachine, listening to voters and talking about the issues that matter most to them: affordable groceries, good-paying jobs, and protecting Alaska's fishing industry.
Her message? Put Alaska first. And voters agreed.

**COURSE #2: THE MAIN COURSE**
**Your brother-in-law says: “Democrats just want to raise our taxes!”**
**Your response:** Pass the potatoes, and tell him about **Governor Katie Hobbs** , who just won reelection in the battleground state of Arizona.
In her first term, Katie cut taxes for working families, eliminated the state's rental tax, and helped cancel medical debt for nearly 700,000 Arizonans.
Now, with a brand new Democratic trifecta, she's ready to keep fighting to make life more affordable for Arizona families.
Turns out, Democrats know a thing or two about putting money back in people's pockets.

**COURSE #3: DESSERT**
**Your cousin says: “Democrats are weak on national security!”**
**Your response:** Before anybody starts arguing over the last slice of pie, remind them that voters just sent a historic group of women veterans to Congress.
Women like **JoAnna Mendoza (AZ-06), Jessica Killin (CO-05), Rebecca Bennett (NJ-07), Cait Conley (NY-17), Kristina Knickerbocker (OH-10), Nancy Lacore (SC-01), and Elaine Luria (VA-02)**.
These EMILYs List women have served our country in uniform. Now, they're bringing that same commitment to service, leadership, and protecting Americans to the halls of Congress.
And that's something everyone at the table can be thankful for.

**We can't guarantee a drama-free Thanksgiving.** But regardless, because of supporters like you, we have plenty to be thankful for this year.
Across the country, EMILYs List women won because they offered voters a vision of a safer, more affordable future — one that puts people ahead of politics.
**And with your continued support, we'll keep recruiting, training, and electing Democratic pro-choice women who are ready to deliver for ALL Americans.**

clean_body: Consider this our way of giving thanks. | = Hey there Peter, If your Thanksgiving dinner looks anything like ours, it's got turkey, pumpkin pie, and a healthy side of political debate. Democrats delivered a historic blue wave this election, and that means your Republican relatives just might deliver historic arguments across the table. So consider this our way of giving thanks for your support: our guide to navigating those annoying political Thanksgiving dinner arguments. These talking points all come from real electoral victories that you made happen. EMILYs List women ran on governing for all Americans, no matter their party — and now, they're ready to deliver. = | = YOUR THANKSGIVING POLITICAL SURVIVAL GUIDE Three courses. Three talking points. Zero guarantees of a drama-free dinner. COURSE #1: THE APPETIZER Your uncle says: “The Democrats have gone way too far left!” Your response: Tell him about Sen.-elect Mary Peltola, who just won a U.S. Senate seat in Alaska — a state that voted for Donald Trump in 2024. Mary's campaign wasn't about partisan politics. It was about making life better for working Alaskans. She traveled across the state by plane, boat, and snowmachine, listening to voters and talking about the issues that matter most to them: affordable groceries, good-paying jobs, and protecting Alaska's fishing industry. Her message? Put Alaska first. And voters agreed. COURSE #2: THE MAIN COURSE Your brother-in-law says: “Democrats just want to raise our taxes!” Your response: Pass the potatoes, and tell him about Governor Katie Hobbs , who just won reelection in the battleground state of Arizona. In her first term, Katie cut taxes for working families, eliminated the state's rental tax, and helped cancel medical debt for nearly 700,000 Arizonans. Now, with a brand new Democratic trifecta, she's ready to keep fighting to make life more affordable for Arizona families. Turns out, Democrats know a thing or two about putting money back in people's pockets. COURSE #3: DESSERT Your cousin says: “Democrats are weak on national security!” Your response: Before anybody starts arguing over the last slice of pie, remind them that voters just sent a historic group of women veterans to Congress. Women like JoAnna Mendoza (AZ-06), Jessica Killin (CO-05), Rebecca Bennett (NJ-07), Cait Conley (NY-17), Kristina Knickerbocker (OH-10), Nancy Lacore (SC-01), and Elaine Luria (VA-02). These EMILYs List women have served our country in uniform. Now, they're bringing that same commitment to service, leadership, and protecting Americans to the halls of Congress. And that's something everyone at the table can be thankful for. We can't guarantee a drama-free Thanksgiving. Hey folks,
Donald Trump is picking a fight with Mitch McConnell, and the whole thing is a perfect example of what's broken in Washington.
Republicans are racing to confirm Trump's last-minute nominees before Democrats take control of the Senate, but McConnell's office is reportedly holding up one of Trump's picks. And the story behind it is an absolute mess.
We've got MAGA infighting, political favors, an aging political establishment, and a Republican Party that seems more interested in rewarding its friends than addressing the problems Americans are facing.
Here's what we get into:
* [**00:00:27**] Trump takes a shot at Mitch McConnell on Truth Social as a fight over a key nomination exposes tensions inside the Republican Party.
* [**00:03:06**] Who is Nate Morris? We break down how Trump pushed the Kentucky Senate candidate out of the race and offered him an ambassadorship.
* [**00:05:00**] Morris's campaign attacks on McConnell come back into focus as his nomination runs into resistance.
* [**00:08:41**] Republicans face a shrinking window to confirm Trump's nominees before Democrats take control of the Senate in January.
* [**00:11:35**] Why this fight is about something much bigger: Washington's aging leadership, political corruption, affordability, and the need for a new generation of public servants.

Here's what really matters to me: **Corruption and affordability are connected.** When Washington spends its time handing out political favors and fighting over who gets which powerful job, working families are left wondering why nobody is doing anything about their healthcare costs, housing, groceries, or wages.
And this isn't just a Republican problem. Democrats have their own responsibility to confront the political establishment, demand transparency, and prove that winning elections actually means making people's lives better.
We have an opportunity to build a new generation of leadership that understands what Americans are going through. But that means holding both parties accountable and refusing to accept business as usual.
That's the work we're committed to at Endless Urgency. If you value independent media that calls out corruption, challenges the powerful, and keeps the focus on working people, help me keep these conversations going.

Y’all knocked doors in the summer heat. You made calls, sent texts, and talked to your neighbors.
You chipped in, even when the political pundits said the odds weren’t in our favor.

From my family to yours, wishing you a happy Thanksgiving.
Have a wonderful holiday,
Aaron

name: David Hogg
subject: Thank you, Peter
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY LEADERS WE DESERVE, LEADERSWEDESERVE
body:
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20261125-1&t=1&akid=4263%2E587540%2EDBHUSs)
Peter,
Before we all (hopefully) log off for the holiday, I want to say something I don’t think I can say enough:
**_THANK YOU._**
Last Thanksgiving, I told you how Leaders We Deserve started: with a dream, a lot of risk, and the $5 I put into our ActBlue to make sure it worked. A year later, I can tell you that dream just had its best year yet.
This year, we endorsed 55 candidates across the country, the most in our organization’s history. **And after Election Day, 36 of them have won.** These are young visionaries who’ll now be sitting in state legislatures and Congress because you believed in the next generation of leaders.
Our candidates were also part of something bigger. This November, Democrats won a historic victory up and down the ballot, including in places people had written off for decades. And our generation helped make it happen: we organized, we turned out, and we ran for office ourselves. I really believe this moment can put our country on a better track. If it does, it’ll be because people like you decided not to give up on it.
When we started this organization, I said we were trying to give our generation something it had rarely had: hope. Hope that our government could work for the people instead of the special interests it’s supposed to protect us from. Hope that when our generation finally took power, we wouldn’t just be younger versions of the leaders who failed us.
This year, that hope started to look a lot more like results.
**And none of that would’ve happened without you, Peter.**
Every candidate we trained, every race we showed up for, and every win we celebrated on Election Night traces back to people like you who chipped in, shared our work, and kept believing even when the odds looked long.
So wherever you are this week, whether you’re with family or chosen family, or just catching some well-deserved rest, I hope you know how thankful I am to be in this fight with you.
We have so much more to do, and I can’t wait to do it together. Happy Thanksgiving!
With gratitude today and every day,
David

name: Derek Tran
subject: No waiting this year
body:
Two years ago, I didn’t know I’d won until the day before Thanksgiving. |
# [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/144039516/662220369/439559405?refcode=em-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDg3ODciLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNDllZTgwNTAtZTllOC1mMTExLTkxZjMtMDAwZDNhNTMzMTliIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=XYhnuFkalEphsiFPnawzYJXRfK5dIjW-gGf82v2gNF0=)
Two years ago, I didn’t know if I’d won my race until the day before Thanksgiving. It took 22 days to count every ballot in CA-45, so when my family sat down to eat that year, I was still getting used to the idea that I was headed to Congress. This year, the votes are counted and the race is behind us. I get to spend the holiday with my family without checking my phone for updates. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/144039520/662220374/439559405?refcode=em-11.25.26-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDg3ODciLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNDllZTgwNTAtZTllOC1mMTExLTkxZjMtMDAwZDNhNTMzMTliIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=XYhnuFkalEphsiFPnawzYJXRfK5dIjW-gGf82v2gNF0=) My parents came to this country as refugees with almost nothing and built a life for us behind the counter of a corner store. Thanksgiving in our home was always a reminder of the opportunities this country gave us. Michelle and I try to pass that on, and this year I’ll actually be fully present for all of it. None of this happens without the people who stuck with this campaign for two years. You stayed with us through a race a lot of people said we couldn’t hold, and because of you, I get to keep doing this work for families across Orange and Los Angeles Counties. clean_body: Two years ago, I didn’t know I’d won until the day before Thanksgiving. | = Two years ago, I didn’t know if I’d won my race until the day before Thanksgiving. It took 22 days to count every ballot in CA-45, so when my family sat down to eat that year, I was still getting used to the idea that I was headed to Congress. This year, the votes are counted and the race is behind us. I get to spend the holiday with my family without checking my phone for updates. = My parents came to this country as refugees with almost nothing and built a life for us behind the counter of a corner store. Thanksgiving in our home was always a reminder of the opportunities this country gave us. Michelle and I try to pass that on, and this year I’ll actually be fully present for all of it. None of this happens without the people who stuck with this campaign for two years. You stayed with us through a race a lot of people said we couldn’t hold, and because of you, I get to keep doing this work for families across Orange and Los Angeles Counties. Wherever you’re celebrating tomorrow, I hope you get some rest and a second plate. Happy Thanksgiving, Derek T. ---
There comes a moment in every man’s life where you wonder how history will remember you.
---
Standing beside President Trump in the White House, I got my answer: **_History will remember that Rudy W. Giuliani was a FIGHTER._**
---
[](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
__
---

[DEFEND RUDY](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---

**The President just awarded me with the Medal of Freedom – the highest civilian honor in America – for the tremendous sacrifices I’ve made in pursuit of freedom.**
---
I’ve paid an ENORMOUS price for defending President Trump as his lawyer and for refusing to bend the knee when the Deep State tried to break me:
---
**_...Arrested and treated like a common criminal

...Armed agents tearing through my home at Biden’s orders

...Pushed to the brink of bankruptcy

...Staring down 20 years in a prison cell
_**
---
The Deep State can imprison me, they can take away my home, they can bankrupt me, they can disbar me, they can rob me of every single one of my possessions.
---
But they will __NEVER__ get me to surrender my principles.
---
Possessions come and go. Even the Medal of Freedom that I’m holding right now will one day be gone from my hands.
---

---
**That’s why I’m going to KEEP FIGHTING for my freedom and justice until the bitter end – even as I walk out of the White House into the most dangerous ambush in my life.**
---
**A vengeful Democrat Attorney General is making me stand in a rigged trial for bogus state-level crimes, because she knows that not even the most powerful man on the face of the planet – President Trump – can save me with a _federal_ pardon in _state_ court.**
---
**Not only that, the Left is also trying to use every form of lawfare in their arsenal to bleed me dry and BANKRUPT.**
---
But now, as I fight with all I’ve got, I have only one place left to turn to help me reach the finish line and secure my freedom: _good and honest Americans like _YOU__.
---
Friend, I understand this was probably the last thing on your mind today. I get it. And that’s why I always say that if you can’t afford to help me in this fight, please delete this message and carry on with your day. Don’t even think twice about it.
---
**_But if you can help, I’m going to need the best defense I can get to WIN the final battle for my freedom. I cannot walk into that courtroom outgunned against an unlimited taxpayer-funded war chest designed to lock me up for the rest of my life._**
---

| | I'm thankful for a lot this year. But at the top of the list, it has to be how **our democracy continues to prevail.** And it continues to prevail because of _you._ Over the last two years, you refused to give in to fear. You stood steadfast to defend our core values. You never stopped working to create positive change in your communities — and you never let the intimidation efforts of the Trump administration deter you. **You helped lay the groundwork for a momentous election that has put a critical check on Trump's authoritarianism, given us a real opportunity for accountability, and opened the door to reset our politics and advance progress.** At a time when our democracy was pushed to the brink, you believed in its possibilities. You fought for our core values. And those values were strengthened on Election Day in ways that will reverberate for years to come. We cannot look at the future with complacency — the work left remains urgent. But there is so much reason to have newfound hope. And I am so, so thankful to you for fueling that hope. name: Kristen McDonald Rivet
subject: Happy Thanksgiving, friend! 🦃
body:
|
#
Happy Thanksgiving, friend! 🦃 I hope you and your loved ones are able to rest, relax, and enjoy lots of good food and fun. Between Thanksgiving dinner and the holiday rush, my family and I have been taking the time to reflect on what we’re most thankful for this year. It’s a simple tradition, but it always reminds me to appreciate the little things in life and the special people who make it meaningful – **like you all.** Thanks to everyone who chipped in, gave their time, and spread our message throughout the district, I get to keep fighting for our community – and for that, I’m so grateful. It’s been the greatest honor of my life to be able to serve mid-Michigan – and I’m excited to continue this work. But for now, I’ll be enjoying this time with my family – and I hope you do the same! name: George Whitesides
subject: Wishing you a Happy Thanksgiving, Peter!
body:
Happy Thanksgiving, Peter!

I have a lot to be grateful for this year.

I’m thankful to the people of the Antelope Valley, Santa Clarita Valley, and San Fernando Valley for trusting me with a second term. Serving this community is the honor of my lifetime.

I’m thankful for my wife and kids, who’ve put up with two years of cross-country flights and one more campaign. I suspect they’re most thankful the ads are finally off the air.

I’m thankful for our casework team, who helped return over $15 million in federal benefits that seniors, veterans, and local businesses were owed.

And I’m thankful for you, Peter. Every door knocked, every dollar chipped in, and every conversation with a neighbor added up to a win in one of the toughest races in the country.

In January, I’ll head back to Washington as part of a new Democratic majority, focused on lowering costs and holding this administration accountable. I don’t take your support for granted, and I’m glad to have you with me for what comes next.

Wishing you and your loved ones a happy Thanksgiving.

Thank you,

George

body:
Find local food assistance and ways to support Northwest Washington families this holiday season.
| | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/144049409/662246474/-201694504?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwODIxN2U3NS1mNWU4LWYxMTEtOTFmMy0wMDBkM2E1MzMxOWIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=0BKVXdQsWDZkN6-Eq4st_uk2Yf2eKfHDtKD-oy2YZh8=&emci=3057bb91-dbe8-f111-91f3-000d3a53319b&emdi=08217e75-f5e8-f111-91f3-000d3a53319b&ceid=9494239)
---

| | Thanksgiving is a time to reflect on what we are grateful for, spend time with loved ones, and look out for our neighbors. But as families across Northwest Washington prepare to gather around the table, many of our neighbors are struggling to put food on theirs. **Over the past year, rising grocery prices and cuts to federal nutrition programs have created real challenges for families across Northwest Washington.** I have heard from local food bank volunteers, employees, and community leaders about the growing demand for food assistance and the challenges they face meeting that need. Our local food banks and community organizations continue to step up to help families put food on the table. But they cannot do it alone. **This Thanksgiving, I want to share a few resources for anyone who needs assistance or wants to lend a helping hand.** **_If you or someone you know needs food assistance:_** There are food banks and community organizations throughout Northwest Washington providing groceries, meals, and other essential services to families in need. [**You can use the Washington 211 resource directory to find food banks, meal programs, and other assistance near you.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/144049410/662246475/-270235867?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwODIxN2U3NS1mNWU4LWYxMTEtOTFmMy0wMDBkM2E1MzMxOWIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=0BKVXdQsWDZkN6-Eq4st_uk2Yf2eKfHDtKD-oy2YZh8=&emci=3057bb91-dbe8-f111-91f3-000d3a53319b&emdi=08217e75-f5e8-f111-91f3-000d3a53319b&ceid=9494239) [FIND FOOD ASSISTANCE](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/144049411/662246476/-270235867?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwODIxN2U3NS1mNWU4LWYxMTEtOTFmMy0wMDBkM2E1MzMxOWIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=0BKVXdQsWDZkN6-Eq4st_uk2Yf2eKfHDtKD-oy2YZh8=&emci=3057bb91-dbe8-f111-91f3-000d3a53319b&emdi=08217e75-f5e8-f111-91f3-000d3a53319b&ceid=9494239) **_If you are looking for ways to give back:_** Our local food banks rely on volunteers, donations, and community support to serve our neighbors. Whether you can donate food, contribute financially, or volunteer your time, every effort makes a difference. Here are a few organizations serving communities across Northwest Washington:

clean_body: Find local food assistance and ways to support Northwest Washington families this holiday season. | | | | Thanksgiving is a time to reflect on what we are grateful for, spend time with loved ones, and look out for our neighbors. But as families across Northwest Washington prepare to gather around the table, many of our neighbors are struggling to put food on theirs. Over the past year, rising grocery prices and cuts to federal nutrition programs have created real challenges for families across Northwest Washington. I have heard from local food bank volunteers, employees, and community leaders about the growing demand for food assistance and the challenges they face meeting that need. Our local food banks and community organizations continue to step up to help families put food on the table. But they cannot do it alone. This Thanksgiving, I want to share a few resources for anyone who needs assistance or wants to lend a helping hand. If you or someone you know needs food assistance: There are food banks and community organizations throughout Northwest Washington providing groceries, meals, and other essential services to families in need. If you are looking for ways to give back: Our local food banks rely on volunteers, donations, and community support to serve our neighbors. Whether you can donate food, contribute financially, or volunteer your time, every effort makes a difference. Here are a few organizations serving communities across Northwest Washington: Island and San Juan Counties: — connects families with food assistance and other essential resources. Skagit County: — connects residents with local food banks and food assistance programs. Snohomish County:— provides hunger prevention services and other community support. Whatcom County: — provides food assistance to individuals and families facing food insecurity. You can also find additional food banks and meal programs throughout Washington through We all have a role to play in building stronger communities. Whether through volunteering, donating to an impactful charity, or simply lending a helping hand — your actions can uplift your neighborhood. # [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/144049575/662247169/-489362013?refcode=em-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjQwNyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2MDQ2OTVlMi1mNWU4LWYxMTEtOTFmMy0wMDBkM2E1MzMxOWIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=7If2VX1CRr9pfiQHAFZXa2c4GwXtQucs7ww_Sn74j5Y=)
Friend, With Thanksgiving just around the corner, I want to personally thank you for all the support you’ve given me since I announced my reelection campaign. This year has been full of challenges for everyone. We watched as the Trump administration stoked fear in our communities by sending ICE agents to our district. We saw so many families here in Central and Southern Illinois impacted by unnecessary wars, high grocery costs and energy bills, and tariffs that only benefited the wealthy and Trump himself. But I’ve also seen hope for a better future. Everywhere I went across IL-13, so many of you reached out to me and my team about the changes you want to see right now. As a result, you and millions of Americans voted for a Democratic majority to lower costs and keep this administration to check. **And as the new Chair of the New Dems Coalition, Americans in red and purple areas are taking charge for a more affordable country – which is both inspiring and exciting to see.** None of this would have been possible without your support – and I am so thankful to keep serving you in Congress. clean_body: | = Friend, With Thanksgiving just around the corner, I want to personally thank you for all the support you’ve given me since I announced my reelection campaign. This year has been full of challenges for everyone. We watched as the Trump administration stoked fear in our communities by sending ICE agents to our district. We saw so many families here in Central and Southern Illinois impacted by unnecessary wars, high grocery costs and energy bills, and tariffs that only benefited the wealthy and Trump himself. But I’ve also seen hope for a better future. Everywhere I went across IL-13, so many of you reached out to me and my team about the changes you want to see right now. As a result, you and millions of Americans voted for a Democratic majority to lower costs and keep this administration to check. And as the new Chair of the New Dems Coalition, Americans in red and purple areas are taking charge for a more affordable country – which is both inspiring and exciting to see. body:
Back from orientation, grateful for this team, and ready to get to work. | |
Peter, **Now that I’m back from two weeks of freshman orientation in Washington, I’m able to take a breath and say thank you.** Through every up and down of this campaign, you kept showing up. You believed in making government a positive force in people’s lives again, so people can survive and thrive and have hope for the future. That’s what this work is about. At orientation, I met a nurse practitioner who spent hours trying to get AI-driven denials of her patients’ care overturned, and a fellow LGBTQ state legislator who flipped a deeply Republican district. These are the people I’ll be serving alongside. We’re already talking about how to deliver, and I came home excited to get to work. The freshman class makes up about a quarter of the House and we’re going to shake things up. We’re going to deliver on the things we promised – like campaign finance reform, a ban on stock trading, committee chair term limits. We know we’re pushing the envelope – that’s why you elected us. This is the most diverse House Democratic leadership in history. The first Black speaker in U.S. history, a woman majority leader, a Latino whip, a Chinese American caucus chair, the first trans member of leadership (_take that, Nancy Mace!_) and many more! I ran for Congress to lower the cost of living, protect access to health care, and stand up to Donald Trump and his administration when they threaten our communities and our fundamental rights. You helped get me here. I want to keep you part of what comes next. **Which part of the work ahead would you like to hear more about first?** | [LOWERING THE COST OF LIVING](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/144051936/662254810/-766187335?refcode2=lowering_cost_of_living&refcode=sw_en_em_90DOAD_261125&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDY5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwYzE0MjM0Ny1mYmU4LWYxMTEtOTFmMy0wMDBkM2E1MzMxOWIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=zfE-6Y-PDYNADN1KwOBh8mIkjaxrpV_WkFqoNBNflH0=&emci=b9118e79-6ee8-f111-91f3-000d3a533978&emdi=0c142347-fbe8-f111-91f3-000d3a53319b&ceid=53530144)

clean_body: Back from orientation, grateful for this team, and ready to get to work. | | Peter, Now that I’m back from two weeks of freshman orientation in Washington, I’m able to take a breath and say thank you. Through every up and down of this campaign, you kept showing up. You believed in making government a positive force in people’s lives again, so people can survive and thrive and have hope for the future. That’s what this work is about. At orientation, I met a nurse practitioner who spent hours trying to get AI-driven denials of her patients’ care overturned, and a fellow LGBTQ state legislator who flipped a deeply Republican district. These are the people I’ll be serving alongside. We’re already talking about how to deliver, and I came home excited to get to work. The freshman class makes up about a quarter of the House and we’re going to shake things up. We’re going to deliver on the things we promised – like campaign finance reform, a ban on stock trading, committee chair term limits. We know we’re pushing the envelope – that’s why you elected us. This is the most diverse House Democratic leadership in history. The first Black speaker in U.S. history, a woman majority leader, a Latino whip, a Chinese American caucus chair, the first trans member of leadership (take that, Nancy Mace!) and many more! I ran for Congress to lower the cost of living, protect access to health care, and stand up to Donald Trump and his administration when they threaten our communities and our fundamental rights. You helped get me here. I want to keep you part of what comes next. Which part of the work ahead would you like to hear more about first? | Thank you for being part of this team. Friend,
Before you carve the turkey or whatever your Thanksgiving plans may be, we wanted to send a quick message to thank you.
Whether you’ve given your time, money, or simply read our emails, your support makes all the difference. It’s through your support we were able to engage Nevada voters and _deliver the biggest wins Nevada has ever seen_.
Through your support, we delivered historic wins: from electing Aaron Ford, first Black Governor west of the Mississippi River, to Tya Mathis-Coleman, the first Black woman elected to a statewide executive office in Nevada, to Teresa Benitez-Thompson, first Democrat to represent our 2nd congressional district.
We send you a lot of requests asking for support, and we know we’re not the only ones. We appreciate you and just know the relief we feel knowing we can count on you to show up for us time and time again.
YOU are what makes our victories in Nevada possible and so sweet.
Thanks for being with us in the fight,
NV Dems

Peter, On Monday, I joined Clark County Commissioner William McCurdy II in Las Vegas to hand out hundreds of Thanksgiving turkeys for the fourth year in a row. Being able to provide families with Thanksgiving dinner has become one of my favorite traditions. At a time when so many families across America are struggling with rising costs, the holidays can bring added stress. No one should have to choose between putting Thanksgiving dinner on the table or keeping the lights on. **And when a neighbor is worried about making ends meet, showing up can make a real difference.** No matter our politics or disagreements, we are bound together by a shared belief in community, dignity, and taking care of each other. I’m grateful to everyone who cooked a meal, packed a bag of groceries, or took time out of a busy week to lend a hand. I hope this holiday gives you a chance to spend time with the people you love and to check in on someone who could use a hand. From my family to yours, Happy Thanksgiving. Onward,
Ro

# [Hot PCE locks December hike as AI stocks crater](https://substack.com/redirect/ecda1d4c-a278-44a2-b6da-09b5f31ec7d0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Nasdaq futures sank nearly 3% and selling widened after the open as October Personal Consumption Expenditure **[held at 3.8% headline](https://substack.com/redirect/8b591285-6f6c-4eb1-bf64-c006a09a2eaf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** and core printed a tick hot at 3.3%, locking in expectations for a quarter-point Fed increase on Dec. 9.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ecda1d4c-a278-44a2-b6da-09b5f31ec7d0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Hot PCE print** : Headline personal-consumption expenditures rose 3.8% year-over-year while core accelerated to 3.3%, above the 3.2% consensus and the highest core since November 2023.
* **Futures plunge** : Overnight Nasdaq 100 futures dropped as much as 3.1% and S&P 500 futures fell near 2% before the data hit.
* **Selling widens** : Early Wednesday trade pushed the Nasdaq down 3.7%, the S&P 500 down 2.6% and the Dow down more than 800 points as losses spread beyond chips.
* **Tariff overlay** : Fresh Section 301 proposals on 14 trading partners added to pressure on tech and growth names into the Thanksgiving break.

# [Huang's Nvidia comeback fades into therapy and a stock drop](https://substack.com/redirect/ecda1d4c-a278-44a2-b6da-09b5f31ec7d0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Jensen Huang's Monday reinstatement as Nvidia CEO has **[already given way to another selloff](https://substack.com/redirect/305859c8-dfa3-4762-be3e-01f30003106c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** , with the executive telling staff he is in daily therapy and apologizing while lawmakers schedule December hearings and the shares fall further.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ecda1d4c-a278-44a2-b6da-09b5f31ec7d0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Therapy and apology** : At a Tuesday all-hands, Huang said he spends 90 minutes a day in therapy, apologized for code-of-conduct breaches, and disclosed additional affairs to the board before his return.
* **No succession plan** : He told employees a formal successor would create unnecessary hierarchy, leaving Nvidia without a designated backup after his 11-day exit.
* **Congress schedule** : Private interviews with three House committees are set for Dec. 1 and a public Senate Banking hearing for Dec. 3 on chip exports and the reported ties.
* **Trump comments** : The president said a pardon is always an option and it is not too late for a U.S. stake, while disclosure filings show he holds Nvidia shares worth tens of millions.

# [Jury convicts Huawei on Iran sanctions, fraud and trade secrets](https://substack.com/redirect/ecda1d4c-a278-44a2-b6da-09b5f31ec7d0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
A Brooklyn **[federal jury convicted Huawei](https://substack.com/redirect/9b8e831c-5b8d-4ceb-862c-22dd93384333?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** and three subsidiaries on 10 of 12 counts, including conspiracy to steal U.S. trade secrets, bank and wire fraud, and Iran sanctions violations, while acquitting the company of racketeering.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ecda1d4c-a278-44a2-b6da-09b5f31ec7d0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Mixed verdict** : Jurors found the Chinese tech giant guilty on the trade-secret, fraud and sanctions charges but cleared it of the racketeering conspiracy that would have labeled it a criminal enterprise.
* **Trial length** : The verdict followed a three-month trial; Huawei said the conviction lacked legal or factual merit and signaled it would pursue further legal action.
* **Iran links** : Prosecutors alleged a two-decade scheme that included lying to banks about work with Iran.
* **China response** : The company has rejected the outcome and indicated it will contest the findings.

# [Trump proposes new tariffs on China, EU and 12 others](https://substack.com/redirect/ecda1d4c-a278-44a2-b6da-09b5f31ec7d0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The U.S. Trade Representative unveiled proposed Section 301 duties on[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/11c37f78-596c-4730-a739-983677539d45?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[14 trading partners after an excess-capacity probe,](https://substack.com/redirect/11c37f78-596c-4730-a739-983677539d45?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/11c37f78-596c-4730-a739-983677539d45?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)with China facing an additional 20% rate and several others at 15%, a move that added to Wednesday's futures pressure.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ecda1d4c-a278-44a2-b6da-09b5f31ec7d0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Scope of probe** : The investigation covers China, the European Union, Japan, South Korea, India, Vietnam and others, with higher rates possibly taking effect in January.
* **China rate** : The proposal layers a 20% duty on China atop existing measures, with a higher 40% rate possible if talks collapse.
* **Market reaction** : The announcement hit Nasdaq futures and Nvidia shares as investors digested another potential tariff round.
* **Truce context** : The timing comes as Washington and Beijing weigh whether to extend their current trade arrangement.

| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ecda1d4c-a278-44a2-b6da-09b5f31ec7d0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

* **AI orders** : Management pointed to a large AI server backlog and continued hyperscaler demand even as the stock moved lower.
* **Timing issue** : The beat arrived on a day of broad tech selling, with Dell down alongside Nvidia and other AI-linked names.

# [Thanksgiving dinner hits $58.63 as turkey jumps 10%](https://substack.com/redirect/ecda1d4c-a278-44a2-b6da-09b5f31ec7d0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The American Institute for Economic Research's 2026 Thanksgiving Cost Index rose[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/33fe11be-98a8-43d4-8df1-780cde67eabf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[2.6% from a year earlier and 32.1% above 2019](https://substack.com/redirect/33fe11be-98a8-43d4-8df1-780cde67eabf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** levels to a record, led by an 8.4% jump in turkey and poultry prices amid avian flu and higher diesel costs.

---|---|---
* **Index rise** : The AIER measure reached an all-time high, with turkey and poultry the largest contributors to the year-over-year increase.
* **Drivers** : Avian flu outbreaks and elevated diesel costs pushed the poultry component higher.
* **Longer view** : The index stands 32.1% above its 2019 level.
* **Consumer impact** : The record reading arrives as households prepare for the holiday amid broader price pressures.

# [Oil falls as surplus fears overpower Middle East risks](https://substack.com/redirect/ecda1d4c-a278-44a2-b6da-09b5f31ec7d0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Crude prices declined as traders[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/af583965-7748-4cb0-8285-f188416c7f4f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[weighed a prospective global supply surplus](https://substack.com/redirect/af583965-7748-4cb0-8285-f188416c7f4f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/af583965-7748-4cb0-8285-f188416c7f4f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)ahead of an OPEC+ meeting this weekend against renewed Saudi-Houthi hostilities that raised concerns about Red Sea shipping.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ecda1d4c-a278-44a2-b6da-09b5f31ec7d0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Supply outlook** : Falling prices reflected expectations of rising production and a looming surplus, with Brent holding near $90 despite geopolitical risks.
* **Middle East factor** : Renewed attacks and tensions in the region failed to offset the downward pressure from supply assessments.
* **OPEC+ timing** : The moves came ahead of the group's weekend meeting, with Iraq separately rejecting an assessment that its sustainable capacity is under 5 million barrels a day.
* **Product demand** : Soft refined-product demand added to the pressure even as shipping concerns persisted around Hormuz and the Red Sea.

# [Consumer confidence jumps to 103.3 after midterms](https://substack.com/redirect/ecda1d4c-a278-44a2-b6da-09b5f31ec7d0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The Conference Board's **[consumer-confidence index rose to 103.3](https://substack.com/redirect/8ab0dc94-2318-41fc-aeff-863f0ee6e734?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** in November, far above the 92.2 forecast and the highest since January 2025, with sharp gains in both current conditions and near-term outlooks following the midterms.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ecda1d4c-a278-44a2-b6da-09b5f31ec7d0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Index jump** : The headline measure increased roughly 11 points, marking the biggest two-month rebound since the COVID vaccine period.
* **Labor views** : Improvement was led by a sharp rise in assessments of the job market, with gas prices below $4 a gallon also cited as a factor.
* **Analyst skepticism** : Some researchers dismissed the rebound as having limited predictive value for actual spending, calling the survey unreliable.
* **Timing** : The release came Tuesday as markets digested mixed equity moves and ahead of the Wednesday inflation data.

This Thanksgiving we take a moment to hone in on what we’re really thankful for: you. We have a rare opportunity over the next few months for big, bold, transformational change out of Harrisburg with the incoming trifecta. Even in the face of MAGA billionaires like Elon Musk and Jeffrey Yass, we put in the work and the people prevailed knocking on 60,000 doors in districts where incumbent Republicans lost. This win was a labor of love spanning years of political education and mobilization in Pennsylvania’s working class communities. For now, we hope you are able to spend this Thanksgiving with good people and good health. Rest up because organizing is a year-round effort and we’ll be reaching out to have you join us for what’s next. Cheers,
One PA Action Team
---
| One PA is a grassroots movement for racial, economic, and social justice in Pennsylvania. We empower Black communities through voter education, endorse candidates who share our values, and prioritize leadership development. Our commitment is to challenge political disillusionment, protect and expand democracy, and unite everyday people to have a voice in our political system.

I have a PhD in clinical psychology, which allows me to see my family clearly – and it’s clear that Donald is a textbook narcissist. He has always felt that his needs and desires come above everyone else – that’s why he directed his supporters to the Capitol on January 6th, why he’s plastering his name on everything he can, and why he’s threatening to steal this November’s election. His supporters enable this narcissism, but nothing bruises a narcissist’s ego like people who refuse to be intimidated by them. She was a young Judiciary Committee staffer during Nixon's impeachment. She sat on that same committee for Clinton's impeachment. Donald has since called for the members of that committee to be prosecuted. Zoe has never blinked once. That is what actual strength looks like.
It’s no secret that the GOP is terrified right now. Donald’s approval rating is tanking, and he’s bringing the whole party down with him.

# WEDNESDAY, NOVEMBER 25, 2026
---
**
Dear Reader,**

With the end of the year almost here, I'm writing with a personal ask.

Nobody knows what comes next. Things are shifting in Washington, and statehouses across the country are rewriting the rules. Markets are swinging, and the financial ground under everyday Americans feels less steady every week. At a time like this, what you need most is information you can trust.

That kind of information is disappearing.

Media companies across the country keep going bankrupt. Some made bad business decisions. Some traded facts for partisan spin. Some never figured out the internet. When they fail, they leave a gap.

So ask yourself: **who 's going to fill it?
**
Can you rely on CNN for unbiased news? The New York Times? Facebook's algorithm?

You know the answer.

**You can rely on _The Flyover_.** For almost four years you've trusted us to shoot straight. No spin, no agenda, just the facts every morning. Millions of Americans now feel the same way:
* **Over 7 million readers** get _The Flyover_ every day
* **12 state editions** cover the news closest to home
* **Our podcast** reaches millions of listeners every month
