I’ve spent the week trying to find a better word than “grateful.” There isn’t one. So grateful will have to do — as a start. This year, millions of people said loudly and clearly that we deserve better. They stood up for their neighbors and for the most vulnerable among us. They reached across disagreement to find common ground. I’m proud of every bit of it. And yes, grateful. Now it’s on Democrats to earn the trust voters just placed in us. I’m ready. My team and I are already at work on legislation for the new Congress, and I’ll have more to share soon. For now, I’m taking a short break like everyone else, and I’m heading straight for the sweet potato casserole. I hope you get some time this week with the people you love, a plate of your own favorite food, and a moment to take in how far we’ve come. Happy Thanksgiving. —Sara P.S. Here’s the recipe my mom and I use for our go-to sweet potato casserole!
---
_Ruth’s Chris Sweet Potato Casserole Recipe:_
\- 3/4 cup brown sugar
\- 1/4 cup flour
\- 3/4 cup chopped nuts (pecans preferred)
\- 1/4 cup melted butter
\- 3/4 cup sugar
\- 1/4 teaspoon salt
\- 1/4 teaspoon vanilla
\- 2 cups mashed sweet potatoes
\- 1 egg, well beaten
\- 1/4 cup butter Process:
1\. Combine crust mixture in mixing bowl and put to one side.
2\. Combine sweet potato mixture ingredients in a mixing bowl in the order listed. Combine thoroughly.
3\. Pour sweet potato mixture into buttered baking dish
4\. Sprinkle crust mixture evenly onto surface of sweet potato mixture.
5\. Bake for 30 minutes at 350°. Allow to set for at least 30 minutes before serving.

| | | Being a parent is hard enough without having to worry about whether the diapers you put on your kid are safe. This week, I led a bipartisan effort calling on the Consumer Product Safety Commission to recall Millie Moon diapers following hundreds of reports of painful rashes, blistering, and chemical burns in babies. We're demanding answers about the materials used in these diapers, how they're manufactured, and what steps are being taken to ensure they're safe. The company maintains that its products have passed independent testing, but parents deserve answers about the injuries being reported. This isn't the first time I've led on an issue like this. Remember when parents were driving from grocery store to grocery store just to find baby formula? Last year, I secured an amendment in the House Appropriations Committee to investigate corporate consolidation in the infant formula industry and identify ways to increase competition. I've also been working to rebuild our domestic pulp and paper industry, protect your right to repair the things you own, crack down on shrinkflation, and require manufacturers to tell you how long the appliances you're buying are actually expected to last. These issues might seem unrelated, but they're rooted in a lot of the same questions: where our goods are made, who controls their production, and what protections consumers have when something goes wrong. Whether it’s the diapers you put on your kid, the formula you feed them, or the appliances you spend your hard-earned money on, you ought to know that what you’re buying is safe, that it works, and that the companies making it can be held accountable when something goes wrong. **[Will you make a contribution today to help me keep fighting for families across the district?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/144055752/662265532/-995582223?refcode=261123-recall&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NTkyOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3ZTliZmQ0MS0wNWU5LWYxMTEtOTFmMy0wMDBkM2E1MzMxOWIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=sCDJIMp7y3pmH6ZUpwBEnzvgvXAZEZElqvYZVEuNf5w=)**

name: Mark Trammell
subject: They put him in the hospital
body:
When Antifa attackers beat Andy Ngo, we took his case and won.

| | | |
---
Friend,
---
| | | My name is Mark Trammell. I lead the **Center for American Liberty.**

We're a nonprofit law firm. We defend Americans who are being silenced, pushed out, and left to fight alone.

This time of year, a lot of people think about giving. Let me tell you a story about why giving matters.

**It 's about my friend Andy Ngo.**
---
[](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckbGO2zAMhp9G3s6waEtxBg8FggAdrijQoaNAU0xMVLJci77i3r7IXcZOXfn__D4Q_PkaXlGSrPdvmHmSWsNegy78vh26SJZVF15K3UQxBejAv1j7Ai4gqbxxGLCJkwM73saGJ3s6O9-7DlyzTBhHT-hmP55nQgcMbkSYiSwwR5gbmR48a8HZc9_B0NI488lavLF31p9HM3THFlG5lbVK5EqlbFtJokK1Lfu9SdOiulXTfzFwNXDFlWPRNsnMu74Tr8r7o2jgSjdM4RlkVFo-rglIv01_reXYiQOVyKa_fP3x3frBDdaAPzSHzFGObPoLZ5T0HH6umP6y4B6x_vogfUaEeUO5r6a__Nv67CnvD2qzT3H7IylJ9SczdPeHpaWSG_2vh7xN8DcAAP__xzie7A)
---
You may have seen Andy on Fox News. He has testified before Congress and spoken at the White House about Antifa and the violent far Left.

In 2019, Andy was in Portland covering Antifa when a mob attacked him.

They beat him. He ended up in the hospital with bleeding in his brain.

Plenty of groups wouldn't touch his case. Too controversial. Too risky.

**The Center for American Liberty took it anyway. **

name: LCV Membership Team
subject: Beyond grateful
body:
To view this mail in a browser, copy https://links.messages.lcv.org/servlet/MailView?ms=MTQxMjIxNjAS1&r=NjA3MDU0MTAzNTc3S0&j=MjU4MDEyNTkyNAS2&mt=1&rt=0 into your browser.
Peter, It’s been an incredible week — and we couldn’t have achieved these historic
victories without you. Together with our state affiliates, we helped elect pro-climate majorities in
the U.S. House and Senate, secured new pro-clean energy trifecta governments in
six states (and counting!), and helped elect climate and democracy champions at
every level of government across the country. Thank you. These decisive victories are a resounding rejection of Trump’s dirty energy
policies, which are enriching Big Oil and corporate CEOs at our expense. Voters across the country made it clear that they’re fed up with Trump and MAGA
Republican policies jacking up their energy bills, dirty data centers polluting
their communities, and corporate corruption being allowed to run rampant. We listened to these voters, we strategized, and we got to work. With your support, LCV Victory Fund and affiliated entities launched electoral
programs that harnessed voters’ anger over Trump’s failed energy policies,
provided them with clear solutions, and transformed their desire for change into
action. While some races have yet be called, thanks to supporters like you, we were able
to: Win in 29 races to secure a pro-clean energy, pro-democracy majority in the U.S. House.Protect and pick up seven seats in the U.S. Senate, helping climate champions win in IA, ME, MI, NC, NH, OH, and TX and flipping the chamber.Elect 18 governors, including three who flipped their state’s governor’s mansion from red to blue.Secure six new pro-clean energy, pro-democracy state legislative majorities (so far).Win seats on local and state utility boards, state Supreme Courts, and other offices that have an outsized impact on clean energy and climate policy, including an outright majority on the Georgia Public Service Commission to control energy policy in the state.Defeat every single anti-environment candidate on our Dirty Dozen list https://links.messages.lcv.. And this is just the beginning. LCV is ready to tackle high utility bills by advancing clean, affordable energy;
rein in polluting data centers; and bring a pro-climate, pro-democracy agenda to
state capitols and Washington, D.C. We couldn’t have reached this pivotal moment without you, Peter. I’m so
excited for what comes next. With fierce commitment, Pete Maysmith

President
League of Conservation Voters P.S. We can’t wait to work with all the new champions who will be coming to
Congress. Our 2026 New Member Guide https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/_ is up on our website and will continue to be updated. This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. If this isn't the best email address at which to reach you,update your contact information https://www.pages08.net/leagueofconservationvoters/forms/ContactInformation?spMailingID=14122160&spUserID=NjA3MDU0MTAzNTc3S0&spJobID=MjU4MDEyNTkyNAS2&spReportId=MjU4MDEyNTkyNAS2.Click here to unsubscribe https://www.pages08.net/leagueofconservationvoters/forms/Unsubscribe?spMailingID=14122160&spUserID=NjA3MDU0MTAzNTc3S0&spJobID=MjU4MDEyNTkyNAS2&spReportId=MjU4MDEyNTkyNAS2 from our supporter list.Send us any comments, criticisms, or feedback here mailto:feedback@lcv.org?subject=, or just reply to this email! Thanks for your support.

name: OnePA Team
subject: Tell Congress to stop the SNAP cost shift before they leave for the year
body:
Congress can still stop the SNAP cost shift to states in its year-end spending package. Tell your lawmakers to protect SNAP before they leave for the year. | |
---
Peter, Tomorrow, families across Pennsylvania and the country will sit down for Thanksgiving dinner, and for a lot of our neighbors, the food on that table depends on SNAP. **More than 5 million people across the country have already lost access to SNAP since Congress passed Trump’s Big Brutal Bill in July 2025.** That same law is now pushing the cost of running SNAP onto the states, and the program was never meant to run this way. As of October, the federal government covers just 25% of SNAP's administrative costs, down from 50% -- that means states are stuck with the other 75%. Starting in October 2027, most states with SNAP payment error rates of 6% or higher will have to pay at least 5% of the benefits families use to buy groceries, up to 15%. It will be the first time in history the federal government has not covered the full cost of SNAP benefits. **Trump and congressional Republicans made this choice on purpose, because they knew our families would be the ones to pay for it.** USDA estimates Pennsylvania will have to spend $138.3 million more each year on SNAP administrative costs, and our state budget covered about $116 million of that on an annual basis. Nationwide, states have budgeted $469 million less than USDA says they need. **Congress can still prevent this harm in its year-end spending package** , one of the must-pass bills lawmakers will take up before they leave for the year. **When thousands of us flood our representatives and senators with letters at once, protecting SNAP becomes much harder for them to leave on the cutting room floor.** [**Tell your representative and senators to protect SNAP in year-end legislation by stopping the SNAP cost shift to states and restoring the federal government's 50% share of the cost of running the program.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm396MCpkY7Ue0aOf7CTWHOaxYPboHoD7dUJ6YPkkGXwX0aNVOKnDR49iUNsE-qsPBBZbq-kxLG_PlYd7IFbtuqidnP54ZJBlqz3zSIu5syEeyCSBRLNObBToFah4550tGP158nxLBna7DVXLW2Kh2fTYxOBcyu6EjbPJS0H8WsW4HHFF9n65vDeelBW75uozyZTUMhfIKctL4f6GkJ45zEAuiTJ4MHW9sY1MaKlrrwP3V3Svgspu8m9oSu9Q05JIeLaYr6Ulfu225Dw7aiQUezzvjSRYAmL2XEVCg-sVyRhPAf0K_czMDpS3xhXh4OiZ9Ron3a5MoEB2T1_jRsixYOnPHsb0eK1PVv_3eK-A7enyikpWs9uxi77HCImGLQD1bV9QBcjC1xCpep1dfRz99vaQUxUuQxdVW1yepVga4mTjfPpDCnWtRgwBo0WTtm1ml0Qbo6uWkcNv2A4zzjoordhkPDMS3wjg2JRS5R1K5uVF3C4aXTOOKWCgwqlrSqOY9QwXk0H_ruEeSHZZDSSUDWPPjGHzIu8Cl_Knj81-jPvmPF6SwpsOJkkxcQC7KUpdbTE/4w1/ty2WZwsLRdW3RTCBct7loQ/h0/h001.b5Ibd-HQensTfHUPh4wBmjEOn-HDHQ6FFBLJ0ksVgwI) Congress must eliminate the shift of SNAP benefit costs to states or, at a minimum, delay it for two years without cuts to SNAP in future years. Lawmakers must also restore the federal government's share of the cost of running SNAP, so states are never forced to choose between feeding families and funding everything else in their budgets.
**If states cut back on SNAP or walk away from it altogether, the people who lose the most are children, older adults, veterans, and people with disabilities who count on the program to put food on the table.** Those are our neighbors, our families, and the people sitting next to us at Thanksgiving dinner.
The burden on states is already larger than USDA estimated, with many states unable to fully cover the funding gap. As state lawmakers write their next budgets, they could face a choice between paying these new costs and cutting other essential services, and some states could even consider leaving SNAP entirely.
[**Tell Congress to stop the SNAP cost shift before it hits families’ grocery budgets.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm396MCpkY7Ue0aOf7CTWHOaxYPboHoD7dUJ6YPkkGXwX0aNVOKnDR49iUNsE-qsPBBZbq-kxLG_PlYd7IFbtuqidnP54ZJBlqz3zSIu5syEeyCSBRLNObBToFah4550tGP158nxLBna7DVXLW2Kh2fTYxOBcyu6EjbPJS0H8WsW4HHFF9n65vDeelBW75uozyZTUMhfIKctL4f6GkJ45zEAuiTJ4MHW9sY1MaKlrrwP3V3Svgspu8m9oSu9Q05JIeLaYr6Ulfu225Dw7aiQUezzvjSRYAmL2XEVCg-sVyRhPAYnuEP0F18I1RvKJ71bTM82pnb7MRNLOqr0a34yrxKXKwJCO6gijKTjv7mwpazB_kAhDabFdZFhSfuVU-MTFBQ4_DVdZRff_Wly_GtlTrdxyg5x4qdMqzhKmQ2_Z1mB57AmO1JLB51mOB3O9HtgsrCQFC-ZnrNfVXcu3PuX4wNKI6olSk337RxOfxM0sYRtigxUqLeL8EtABtNAKStag8siMMykZczF7FDY44RAYZIdEUd4FE7sMbtckNDTdFqmI8XsU4OL5jnEUh_I6FZeICks/4w1/ty2WZwsLRdW3RTCBct7loQ/h2/h001.lu9Ufs0QSaYwYEWwczWd8lpLWolp7UEEJgeckKhl2lQ)
Let's make sure every family in Pennsylvania and across the country has food on the table this Thanksgiving and every day after.
-OnePA

_Formerly All On The Line_

Have you had a moment to catch your breath, Peter?
It's been a few weeks, so I thought it was time to reflect on the lessons from this election cycle.
If nothing else, I believe the midterms were a testament to the fact that we — the people — have the power to protect democracy when we use that power at the ballot box.
**In spite of relentless attacks on fair elections, in spite of a Supreme Court determined to wipe away decades of progress on voting rights, in spite of politicians determined to scare people away from casting their ballots, the will of the people prevailed in this election.**
That's a victory for those of us who believe in representative democracy.
But like all victories in our system of government, there is no guarantee how long it will last, and that is why we must keep up the fight.
**Progress is not always permanent** — we saw that play out painfully when the Court gutted the Voting Rights Act, the crown jewel of the civil rights movement.
But it matters how we respond after setbacks. After the Courts’ disastrous ruling in _Louisiana v. Callais_ , people across the South refused to be counted out – they flexed their voting muscle and swung outcomes many didn't think were possible.
And it matters how we respond after we win — in that limited window in which we have a chance to push for generational change.
**It's time to go for it.** We need to undo the damage done by radical courts and anti-democracy lawmakers in states across the country. These are fights that aren’t won in one election cycle — just as the civil rights movement wasn't about one march or one protest or one landmark law.
But it's equally true that each one of us must seize the opportunity in front of us and do our part, to paraphrase Dr. King, to bend that arc of the moral universe toward justice.
That’s why we do this work. And I’m so grateful to be doing it alongside people like you, Peter.

**Let's lock arms, march forward, and bend that arc together.**
In solidarity,
Eric H. Holder
82nd Attorney General of the United States
